answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 46672 Country: India Title: REGARDING WITR SALAAH Question: Can we pray more duas in witr along with dua-e-qunoot? Answer ID: 46672 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1223/325/B=9/1434) According to Hanafi Fiqh, after reciting the prevalent qunoot (اللھم انا نستعینک الخ) you may recite the following dua as well: اللھم اھدنا فیمن ھدیت وعافنا فی من عافیت الخ This is also qunoot which is recited by the followers of Shafi’i Fiqh. It is alright to combine both the qunoots. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
